tools.name: ploi_get_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated Ploi account: name, email, plan, plan expiry and billing details. Good first call to confirm which account the token belongs to. Ploi API: GET /api/user.

tools.name: ploi_list_servers
tools.description: List the servers in the account with PHP versions, IP address, site count and status. Use it to find server ids for the other tools. Ploi API: GET /api/servers.

tools.name: ploi_get_server
tools.description: Get one server by id: IP address, PHP and MySQL versions, site count, monitoring flag and status. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{id}.

tools.name: ploi_list_server_logs
tools.description: List the activity log entries of one server (paginated, newest first). Use it to see recent changes made on the server. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{id}/logs.

tools.name: ploi_get_server_monitoring
tools.description: Get the latest monitoring statistics for one server (CPU, memory, disk). Monitoring must be installed on the server first. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/monitor.

tools.name: ploi_list_sites
tools.description: List the sites on one server with domain, project type, PHP version, status, last deploy time and disk usage. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/sites.

tools.name: ploi_get_site
tools.description: Get one site by server and site id: domain, web directory, project root, PHP version, deploy settings and status. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/sites/{id}.

tools.name: ploi_list_site_logs
tools.description: List the latest log entries of one site (paginated). Use a log name from this list with ploi_get_site_log. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/sites/{id}/log.

tools.name: ploi_get_site_log
tools.description: Get one site log entry with its full content, by log name from ploi_list_site_logs. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/sites/{id}/log/{log}.

tools.name: ploi_list_deployments
tools.description: List the deployment history of one site, newest first (finished and scheduled deployments). The site needs a repository. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/deployments.

tools.name: ploi_list_certificates
tools.description: List the SSL certificates of one site (type, domain and status). Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/sites/{site}/certificates.

tools.name: ploi_list_databases
tools.description: List the databases on one server with their type and name. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/databases.

tools.name: ploi_list_crontabs
tools.description: List the cron jobs on one server. Needs a token with the cron job read scope. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/crontabs.

tools.name: ploi_list_daemons
tools.description: List the background processes (daemons) on one server. Ploi API: GET /api/servers/{server}/daemons.

tools.name: ploi_deploy_site
tools.description: Start a deployment of one site now. It runs the site's configured deploy script on the live server and returns a deployment_id at once; follow it with ploi_list_deployments. Not safe to repeat: each call starts a new deploy. Ploi API: POST /api/servers/{server}/sites/{id}/deploy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ploi_get_user · Private data: ploi_get_user, ploi_list_crontabs · Public sink: ploi_get_user, ploi_deploy_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ploi_get_user · Private data: ploi_get_user, ploi_list_crontabs · Public sink: ploi_get_user, ploi_deploy_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
